verdict.rationale: PCI scope is a fair question for a payment-accepting POS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions PCI compliance, certified or encrypting card readers, end-to-end card-data capture, or vendor guidance on remaining merchant obligations. The Tap to Pay and contactless-payment citations describe how payments are accepted, not how card data is isolated from the merchant or developer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations
